name: Tellurium
description: Faster chunk generation that produces the same world. Terrain and surface for tested world generators (vanilla, Terralith, Tectonic) are computed on the GPU through Vulkan; structure, carver and feature steps run in parallel; chunks are saved in the background. Includes a pregenerator: /tellurium pregen start <radius>. Works on dedicated servers and in singleplayer; settings in config/tellurium.toml; /tellurium status shows what is active.
